$comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0. Semantics: specs/conformance/dsl.md, and specs/conformance/sync-ops.md for actor scenarios. Authoritative for the scenario file format together with those specs. Not expressed here, checked when a scenario loads: an actor step names a declared actor, and each actor's first sync step has kind login (sync-ops.md S2.3, S4.2).
title: Meguri conformance scenario

allOf.description: actor, sync, net_fault and converge only with actors (sync-ops.md S1).
No handoff in an actor scenario (dsl.md D9.3).
No adopt in an actor scenario (normalized-dump.md N5).

id.description: The file path relative to conformance/scenarios/ without its suffix (D1).

set.description: Pointer patterns of arrays compared as multisets (observations.md O3, O7).

actors.description: The clients of a multi-party scenario; the first runs the setup (sync-ops.md S2).

clock_offset_secs.description: Seconds the server's clock runs ahead of the scenario clock (behind when negative); default 0.

actor_name.description: A Meguri actor (meguri, meguri_2, ...) or an oracle actor (client_a ... client_z), sync-ops.md S2.1.

dump_table.description: A table of a schema-18 collection file (observations.md O8).

media_files.description: media-ops.md F3: files and empty subdirectories created directly in the media folder, after every other setup section; names must differ after NFC under the unicase comparison (checked when the scenario loads).

browser_front.description: dsl.md D6.4: the browser question format (bqfmt); empty when missing.

browser_back.description: dsl.md D6.4: the browser answer format (bafmt); empty when missing.

anyOf.description: media-ops.md F9-F11: media kinds take no references.

render_status.description: render-ops.md Q4: review render status of these cards.

deck_tree.description: deck-ops.md K12: the deck tree's structure (decks/decks.md D12); the queue area adds counts.

decks.description: deck-ops.md K11: every deck by its stored human name.

search.description: search-ops.md S1: searches run in order, each in cards mode (default) or notes mode.

canonical_search.description: search-ops.md S2: canonical texts of search texts; never reads the collection.

db_dump.description: observations.md O8: all twelve tables, or the listed ones; raw true leaves out O8's normalization of random values (normalized-dump.md N4).

type_answer.description: specs/conformance/type-answer-ops.md K1: the type-in comparison over [expected, typed] pairs of strings; never touches the scenario's collection.

review_html.description: specs/conformance/type-answer-ops.md K2: the HTML review shows for stored cards, with the typed text of each case (default empty); at most one request per observe step (checked when the scenario loads).

ignored_before_count.description: deck-options-ops.md E2: the count behind N of M cards included, for each date text.

legacy_json.description: model-ops.md L1: schema-11 objects of the named records.

notetype_structure.description: notetype-ops.md T8: every note type (null), or the named ones.

blob_decode.description: model-ops.md L4: whether the named records' protobuf blobs decode.

package_col.description: model-ops.md L7: col columns of the legacy package an export step wrote.

cloze.description: specs/conformance/cloze-ops.md Z1: pure cloze functions over a list of inputs; [text, card] pairs (card 1-65535), or strings for numbers, which shares a request with no other function.

fsrs_next.description: float-determinism.md F5.1: FSRS next states of a stored review card per input; never touches the scenario's collection. At most one per observe step, params must name a member of param_sets, and f32 members are read per model/json-numbers N2 (checked when the scenario loads).

text.description: observations.md O4 text: pure text functions over a list of inputs; pairs for unicase_compare, which shares a request with no other function.

image_occlusion.description: specs/conformance/image-occlusion-ops.md J1: pure image-occlusion functions over a list of inputs; strings (NFC, no control character but TAB and LF) for parse, lists of field tags (0-4294967295 or null) for fields, which shares a request with no other function.

fsrs_next_input.description: float-determinism.md F2.1: one probe input, the members of a line of conformance/corpora/fp-probe/inputs.jsonl.

media_name.description: media-ops.md F3: an exact name in the media folder.

media_fill.description: media-ops.md F2: size bytes, all equal to byte (default 0).

media_file.description: media-ops.md F2: a name and its bytes, as text (UTF-8) or a fill.

draft_args.description: Draft op arguments (dsl.md D7.2): the owning area fixes them with the driver op.

fields_check_request.description: specs/conformance/note-ops.md N4: the field check on new-note drafts (notetype, fields) or existing-note drafts (note, fields?). Field names and counts are checked when the step runs.

template_request.description: render-ops.md Q1.1: the template engine on given template texts. notetype is required when a case has no card and not allowed otherwise. Field name rules (Q1.1), ord and field-mapping checks are made when the scenario loads.

package_name.description: model-ops.md L6: a package file in the session directory.

open.description: storage-ops.md P1: replace the collection with a copy of conformance/fixtures/<fixture> and open it. Only in scenarios with no setup whose first step is open (checked when the scenario loads).

edit_note.description: Stable (specs/conformance/record-ops.md W2): a note's fields (a list replaces from the first field, a mapping the named ones) and its tags (replaced, in order); the note area may add arguments with their driver support.

delete_notes.description: Stable (record-ops.md W3): notes to remove; those that no longer exist are skipped.

set_config.description: Stable (record-ops.md W4): one collection config key and its JSON value (null included); undoable true records an Update Config undo step (undo-ops.md V3.1).

remove_config.description: Stable (undo-ops.md V3.2): remove one collection config key as an undoable Update Config step; a missing key changes nothing.

undo.description: Stable (undo-ops.md V1): apply the top step of the undo history.

redo.description: Stable (undo-ops.md V1): apply the top step of the redo history.

add_note_tags.description: tag-ops.md G1: add the tags of the text (split at U+0020 and U+3000) to the notes (tags/tags.md T10).

remove_note_tags.description: tag-ops.md G2: remove the matching tags from the notes (tags/tags.md T10).

delete_tags.description: tag-ops.md G3: remove the tags and their descendants from every note and from the registry (tags/tags.md T9).

rename_tag.description: tag-ops.md G4: rename a tag and its descendants (tags/tags.md T7); rejection invalid_name.

reparent_tags.description: tag-ops.md G5: move tags under parent, or to the top level when parent is empty (tags/tags.md T8).

clear_unused_tags.description: tag-ops.md G6: remove registry rows no note uses (tags/tags.md T11).

set_tag_collapsed.description: tag-ops.md G7: set the collapsed state of the named tags, registering missing ones (tags/tags.md T12).

set_flag.description: tag-ops.md G8: write a flag to the cards (tags/flags-and-marked.md F2); rejection invalid_flag above 7.

browser_config_set.description: browser-config-ops.md B1: set one browser config key to a whole value of its shape, without an undo entry.

save_deck_options.description: Stable (deck-options-ops.md E1): the deck options screen's Save for deck, switched to preset, with options applied to that preset and the deck's own desired retention set (a number), removed (null) or kept (missing).

legacy_update.description: model-ops.md L2: merge patch into a record's schema-11 object and save it.

export.description: Draft (package), except the legacy package form {format: apkg, name, legacy: true} (model-ops.md L6).

check_db.description: Stable (collection-check.md K10): Anki's Check Database on the scenario's collection.

media_outside.description: Stable (media-ops.md F4): change the media folder directly, bypassing the store: create or rewrite files, create empty subdirectories, remove entries.

add_media.description: Stable (media-ops.md F5): add a file through the media store; name is the desired name, any string.

trash_media.description: Stable (media-ops.md F6): move these files to the media trash.

restore_media_trash.description: Stable (media-ops.md F7): restore every media trash entry.

empty_media_trash.description: Stable (media-ops.md F8): delete every media trash entry permanently.

db_exec.description: Stable (record-ops.md W1): one SQL statement; params bind to positional ? placeholders (string TEXT, integer INTEGER, other number REAL, null NULL; an integer outside the signed 64-bit range is invalid).

reopen.description: Close the collection and open it again from its file (sync-ops.md S6).

adopt.description: normalized-dump.md N5: give the collection's notes and cards that have no logical id the next #nN and #cN, in ascending id order. Not in actor scenarios.

enable_fsrs.description: Stable (specs/conformance/fsrs-policy-ops.md F2): turn FSRS on without rescheduling. Meguri runs enableFsrs; the oracle runs Anki's deck options save with FSRS on, which must change nothing but cards, the fsrs key and col.mod.

enable_v3.description: Stable (specs/conformance/fsrs-policy-ops.md F3): Anki's scheduler update to the current scheduler. Meguri ensures the session is Hosted, running its real engine-open normalization on promotion.

actor.description: The actor that runs the next steps (sync-ops.md S2.3); declared in actors.

sync.description: sync-ops.md S4; credentials only with kind login (S4.5); status is the sync status of specs/sync/meta-status.md M6.

add_deck.description: deck-ops.md K2: create a deck from a typed name (decks/decks.md D5); rejections filtered_parent, too_deep.

rename_deck.description: deck-ops.md K3: rename a deck, named by its stored human name, to a typed full name (decks/decks.md D6); rejections filtered_parent, too_deep, under_descendant (Meguri only).

reparent_decks.description: deck-ops.md K4: move decks under parent, or to the top level when parent is empty (decks/decks.md D7); rejection filtered_parent.

delete_decks.description: deck-ops.md K5: delete decks with their subdecks and cards (decks/decks.md D8).

set_deck_collapsed.description: deck-ops.md K6: set study_collapsed or browser_collapsed of the decks (decks/decks.md D10).

add_preset.description: deck-ops.md K8: add a preset from the defaults (decks/deck-presets.md P4).

clone_preset.description: deck-ops.md K8: clone a preset (decks/deck-presets.md P5).

rename_preset.description: deck-ops.md K8: rename a preset (decks/deck-presets.md P6).

remove_preset.description: deck-ops.md K9: remove a preset, confirmed, moving its decks to fallback (decks/deck-presets.md P8); rejection default_preset. preset and fallback differ (checked when the scenario loads).

set_deck_preset.description: deck-ops.md K10: assign a preset to a deck, or to it and its subtree (decks/deck-presets.md P9); rejection filtered_deck.

handoff.description: Live scenarios (dsl.md D9.2): the side that runs the next steps; handoffs alternate.

add_notetype.description: notetype-ops.md T2: a note type from scratch, shaped as a setup.notetypes entry.

add_stock_notetype.description: notetype-ops.md T3: one of the six stock kinds, under its name or the given one.

clone_notetype.description: notetype-ops.md T4: a copy of the named note type; name defaults to '<name> copy'.

update_notetype.description: notetype-ops.md T5: edits applied in order to a draft of the named note type, saved once.

ensure_io_notetype.description: notetype-ops.md T6: the on-demand Image Occlusion note type.

notetype_edit.description: notetype-ops.md T5: one edit, a mapping with exactly one key; names refer to the draft as earlier edits left it.
